name: wds_mnist
description: wds_mnist is a WebDataset-packaged version of the MNIST handwritten digit classification dataset, provided for streaming/large-scale data pipelines. It measures image classification performance on digit recognition and is functionally equivalent to standard MNIST benchmarks but optimized for webdataset workflows.
reputation: A canonical, widely used benchmark for digit recognition and a common sanity-check for vision models and pipelines; largely saturated.
